Summarize cached catchmentACS artifacts on disk

Source: R/cache.R
cacs_cache_status.Rd

Reports what is currently stored in each cache namespace: how many .rds entries and fingerprint sidecars exist, how many orphaned temporary files remain, how many entries lack a sidecar, the total size on disk, and the oldest and newest modification times. Use it to size and audit the cache.

Usage

cacs_cache_status()

Value

A tibble with one row per namespace and the columns namespace, n_entries, orphan_tmp, n_fingerprints, orphan_fingerprint_tmp, legacy_entries, total_size_mb, oldest, and newest.

See also

cacs_clear_cache(), cacs_cache_dir(), cacs_get_cache_state(), cacs_set_cache(); cacs_acs_prefetch() and cacs_run() create these entries.

Other cache and configuration: cacs_cache_dir(), cacs_clear_cache(), cacs_get_cache_state(), cacs_set_cache()

Examples

# \donttest{
cacs_cache_status()
#> # A tibble: 4 × 9
#>   namespace n_entries orphan_tmp n_fingerprints orphan_fingerprint_tmp
#>   <chr>         <int>      <int>          <int>                  <int>
#> 1 isochrone         0          0              0                      0
#> 2 acs               0          0              0                      0
#> 3 acs_test          0          0              0                      0
#> 4 intersect         0          0              0                      0
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: legacy_entries <int>, total_size_mb <dbl>, oldest <dttm>,
#> #   newest <dttm>
# }
